description: Read the latest marketplace review of one of your functions, from its listing: the report, whether the listing is public and the listing id. The review is null when the function has no listing or was never reviewed. Pass function_id. Only the owner can read it. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

name: get_function_review
